title: Sumerian King List with kings ruling tens of thousands of years
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Sumerian King List with kings ruling tens of thousands of years, about antediluvian Sumer at Sumer, Mesopotamia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So you have people that are kings that live 40,000 years plus and you have eight kings that are documented and some of them are real.

plain: Joe Rogan, a comedian and podcast host, spoke with podcast host Jesse Michels about the Sumerian King List, an ancient text from Sumer in Mesopotamia, modern Iraq, that names its early rulers. Rogan says it records eight kings who lived and ruled for 40,000 years or more, and that some of them were real people. He brings it up because, if taken at face value, it would hint at a forgotten, very strange chapter of early human history.
